metadata.description: Multi-harness marketplace of AI agents, skills, workflows and MCPs.

plugins.name: academic-paper
plugins.description: Take a research idea to a submission-ready paper: framing, literature grounding, an IMRaD draft, an independent peer-review panel, a citation audit, revision, and the venue's LaTeX template with a submission checklist.

plugins.name: brand-identity
plugins.description: Build and maintain a visual identity: the Brand Guardian persona plus skills for the strategy brief, visual directions, color system, typography system, logo, design tokens, asset kit, brand guidelines, brand review and the full end-to-end process.

plugins.name: edit-book
plugins.description: Editorial and scientific review of a finished book manuscript: a publishability verdict, a panel of review agents, a citation audit, a writing-clarity pass, revision and a final line and copy edit.

plugins.name: launch-readiness
plugins.description: Pressure-test a startup before launch: the Positioning Red Team persona plus the positioning audit, homepage copy audit and competitor research skills.

plugins.name: publish-book
plugins.description: Turn a finished manuscript into upload-ready files: print interiors for paperback and hardcover, a validated EPUB for Kindle, a full-wrap cover, a KDP compliance audit and the store listing.

plugins.name: research-and-citations
plugins.description: Find, read and verify academic sources: a citation-grounded literature review, a check that every reference is real and correctly used, and agents that audit bibliographies, collect papers and assess novelty.

plugins.name: write-article
plugins.description: Take an idea to a publish-ready short piece for LinkedIn, Medium, a newsletter or a blog: angle, targeted fact-check, draft, an editing pass that removes AI tells, and platform formatting.

plugins.name: write-book
plugins.description: Write a technical or scientific nonfiction book from an idea to a review-ready manuscript: outline, literature, chapter drafting with drafting and audit agents, cross-references and an optional executable-chapter method.
